name: Button group
summary: Buttons joined edge to edge into one bar, for a small set of related actions.
description: Use it for actions that belong together, such as previous and next, or a set of formatting commands. When only one option can be chosen at a time, use a segmented control; when each one switches on and off, use a toggle group.

classes.name: v-btn-group
classes.description: Joins its .v-btn children: inner corners go square and borders overlap so there is one line between buttons.

states.description: Groups the buttons for assistive technology. Pair it with aria-label.
On one button, disables just that button.

keyboard.action: Moves between the buttons, one at a time.

a11y: Put role="group" and an aria-label on the wrapper so screen readers announce what the buttons are for.
The focused button is lifted above its neighbours, so the whole focus ring stays visible.
Each button is its own tab stop. Keep groups short; a long row of tab stops is slow to move through.
